main_text.p: xiè timere, vereri: Sollicitudinem, Curam alicujus rei habere, vel gerere. Pahel יצף Idem. Ithpeh. אתיצף Idem.
יצפא יצפא Ch. Anxietas, Sollicitudo, Cura.
ܢܨܦܐ Syr. Idem, Matth.22.14. ܢܨܦܐ ܐܢܐ ܢ ܗܨܠܐ ܢܢܐ Non accipis curam ullius, Non curas quemquam, Matth.22.16.
ܠܐܨܦܐ Syr. Sollicitatio, follicita, anxia, molesta alicujus rei petitio, Importunitas, Lucæ 11.8. Græc. ἀναίδεια, quod Chaldæis proprie est חוצפא vel חציפותא.
ܠܐܨܦܐ Syr. Sollicitè, anxiè, accuratè, Luc.1.3.
יצר Ch. Formare, fingere, ריצר טוריא qui formavit montes, Amos 4.13.
יצרא Ch. Fictio, figmentum: Item Concupiscentia, יצרא טבא Concupiscentia bona: יצרא בישא Concupiscentia mala.
יקר ܐܒܢ Ch. & Syr. Ardere, exardere, succendi, comburi. Aphel אוקיד Incendere, accendere, succendere, comburere. Ithpah. אתוקד Incendi, Comburi.
יקיד Ch. Ardens, Accensus. Fœm. יקידתא, יקידא Accensa, Dan.3.6.26.
יקידתא, יקידא, יקידא Ch. Incendium, ustio, combustio. בית יקידתא Locus combustionis, Focus, Levit.6.2. in Jonath.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek transcribed as far as legible; several Syriac and Hebrew vowel-pointed forms are uncertain and may differ in detail. The small mark after "mala" and the asterisk before "יקב" are reference signs. The final line at lower right is a short Syriac word, uncertain.
